main_issue: Who completes Agent D's half-finished pitch section after her grandmother's death: D herself from home, or A, B and C covering it between them.

A-B.evidence: B first refuses extra work (T6), then offers partial help to A (T12). A thanks B (T13), and they plan to split the rest, with B limiting her share (T32-33).

A-C.evidence: C refuses to split the work with A (T8). C says nothing afterward. A proceeds with 'we' (T32), so C's position is unclear.

A-D.evidence: D insists on finishing from home (T9, T11, T16). A says 'The decision is made' (T17). D gives in: 'Okay. Thank you' (T18), then does the handover (T26).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take on much (T6, T8). They never address each other. B later offers limited help (T12, T33), while C is silent.

B-D.evidence: B tells D 'Go' and offers to help A (T12). D resists at first (T16), then accepts (T18) and hands over the work.

C-D.evidence: C declines the work (T8). D offers to do it herself (T9) and eventually stands down. They never address each other.
